title: refactor(objectql): ScopedContext's two bodies that hand the instance on move into its facet (#30020 S1)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9AVUcBf9iiSFW8k3r6KcyAL)_

Refs #30020
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6687865760

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把 `ScopedContext` 上最后两个"把自己交出去"的方法体(`transaction` 与按符号键的授权补种步骤)搬进 `engine-scoped-context.ts`,方法留在类上做一行转发;拆分脚本新增对应的搬运模式。
- 为什么改:#30020 第 S1 项。按裁决 A,状态仍归类本身,facet 通过 `facade` 端口拿到实例本身;注册表里这两行豁免随之删除(11 → 9)。
- 风险与回滚:纯搬运,撤销证明逐字节还原基线,对外 `.d.ts` 与基线逐字节相同;回滚即 revert 本 PR。`transaction` 在每条事务路径上,已跑 objectql 全量与 dogfood。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/engine-scoped-context.ts`(新增两个静态成员与 `facade` 端口)、`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 末尾的 install 块、`scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` 新增的 members 模式一节。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --scoped --members --verify --base origin/main`,预期输出 "does rebuild the base engine.ts and its scoped modules byte-for-byte"、退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

S1 of the approved §5 order on #30020 (E1, E2 and E3 are on `main`). Rule A (ruling 6687865760): the facade stays the sole state owner; a moved body reads the instance itself through its host's `facade` port.

- `scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` gains the second pass's **members mode**, `--scoped --members Class#member,…` (and `--scoped --members --verify --base REF`). Step 0 measured why it was needed: on `main` `06060c61c`, `--members` is `ObjectQL`-only (`--members names [SEED_USER_GRANTS], which ObjectQL declares as no method`, exit 2) and `--scoped` refuses a split file (exit 2). The mode moves a named scoped method onto the split class into its written facet, exactly as the second pass would have, with:
  - **R1 on an instance host**: a bare `this` the body hands on reads `this.facade`; the class's install block fills it with `facade: instance`, and the host interface types it `readonly facade: ScopedContext`.
  - **R9, a symbol key** (the design's symbol-keyed-member rule): a method keyed `[NAME]`, NAME a module-scope binding spelled SCREAMING_SNAKE, moves into the facet member NAME in camelCase. `[SEED_USER_GRANTS]` becomes `ScopedContextFacet.seedUserGrants`, the same spelling the hand move of `[APP_AUTHORED_HOOK_API]` took (`appAuthoredHookApi`). The stub keeps the key.
  - The facet module's header sentence is rewritten for the new names only; the hand-written words after it (the #30975 note) are kept byte for byte.
  - Shared pieces were factored rather than copied: the fourth pass's import-growth step is now `moduleImportEdits`, the install lines `scopedInstallLines`, the header sentence `scopedHeaderSentence`. Every earlier battery of the self-test still passes unchanged.
- Applied: `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --scoped --members 'ScopedContext#[SEED_USER_GRANTS],ScopedContext#transaction' --write` on `06060c61c`. Both stubs keep their docblock and signature (`async` dropped, as every stub of the series). `return this` (twice) and `callback(this, { owned: false })` read `this.facade`. `engine.ts` 10,740 → 10,647 lines; four import bindings only the moved bodies read leave it (`driverSupportsTransactions`, `redactPropagatedDriverFault`, `resolveUserAuthzGrants`, `rolledBackRefusal`) and arrive in the facet module.
- `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json`: the two `ScopedContext` rows (`[SEED_USER_GRANTS]`, `transaction`) are removed. No other row. `check:facade-delegation-only`: 11 named exceptions on base, 9 on head.
- Changeset `.changeset/30020-scoped-context-facet-bodies.md`, `@objectstack/objectql` patch: the published JS moves even though the `.d.ts` does not, and AGENTS.md reserves `skip-changeset` for a diff that publishes nothing (the delta allowed `skip-changeset`; AGENTS.md wins, declared in the report).

No forced test edits.

## Tests

- objectql typecheck exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: **Test Files 572 passed (572), Tests 11616 passed (11616)** on head; the same command on base `06060c61c`: **572 / 11616**. Base counts held.
- Codemod self-test: **211 cases in 13 batteries** (base: 186 in 12). The new battery, `scoped members, instance identity port and symbol keys (second pass, #30020 S1)`, floor 25: the plan, the proof, determinism, stub / facet / interface / install / header / import shapes, a hand tail kept, seven tampered heads that must fail, and refusals (foreign-private, a key R9 does not take, an unqualified name, an already-moved method, a class declaring `facade`, a non-scoped class).
- Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored with blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - R9 off: self-test exit 2, `ScopedContext#[SEED_KEY] stays on the class …: not-identifier-name`.
  - R1 on the instance host off: self-test exit 2, `… bare-this`.
  - The undo's R1 inverse off: `--scoped --members --verify --base origin/main` exit 1, `undoing the moves does not rebuild the base engine.ts (first difference at line 10436)`.
- Dogfood battery (`ScopedContext.transaction` is on every transactional path), under the verify lock: `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...' && pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` exit 0: **Test Files 440 passed | 3 skipped (443), Tests 3652 passed | 41 skipped (3693)** on head. Not run on base (the skips are the battery's own gated cases, not this diff's).

## Acceptance notes

- `ScopedContextFacet`'s module header says each static method is "the body of the `ScopedContext` method of the same name"; `seedUserGrants` (like the earlier hand-moved `appAuthoredHookApi`) is named by R9, and its placeholder docblock names the method by its key (`ScopedContext#[SEED_USER_GRANTS]`).
- The second pass's own `--scoped --verify` was already not re-runnable on `main` (the #30975 hand moves); this mode carries its own undo proof and does not depend on it.
- Overlap re-check (20:12Z, before opening): of the 40 most recently updated open PRs, the four code PRs near this file set (#31637, #31653, #31655, #31631) touch none of `engine.ts`, `engine-scoped-*.ts`, the registry or the codemod. The WIP branch push (20:05Z) went out before this re-check; the seat's 19:55Z read covered it.

